original_request: Build an original Notepad++-like text/code editor with linting, snippets and important features; use upstream only as a reference, not an exact copy.

clarifications.decision: Save commits document state within the app in memory; Download exports a file to the device.
Platform was consequential and should have been clarified; do not infer a universal desktop requirement for future tasks.

critical_checks.evidence: Submitted agent transcript: browser chosen because the folder was empty and the user had not specified a platform.
User clarifies Save is in-memory. src/App.tsx save() instead creates a Blob and clicks a download anchor.

User rates choice of filename/extension 0/10. Source includes a pencil-triggered rename prompt accepting extensions, so absence of implementation is not established; discoverability/creation flow remains a reported failure.
Submitted final handoff explicitly states no browser interaction or visual inspection. Screenshots show presentation and example state, not the full interaction/cancel/error sequence.

source_evidence.newFile: Creates an in-memory document, activates it, and displays Download-to-save guidance; source does not show automatic download on New.
source_evidence.save: Triggers download and marks the document saved.
source_evidence.rename: Existing control accepts a filename including its extension.

sampling_notes: One user-reviewed task/artifact trajectory. Multiple screenshots, roles, revisions and unit assertions are not independent task samples. User ratings are retained verbatim, not converted into a pass probability. No after-tuning artifact or outcome exists yet.
